comments.author: gsich
comments.story: Android 14 adds support for using your smartphone as a webcam
comments.why: Example review showing MJPEG devices work excellently.
comments.text: This might be implementation dependent. MJPEG per se is not bad as you make it out to be. Example reviews: [VIDEO] and many more. They all boil down to the same thing: excellent device, even with MJPEG. Obviously it's more dependent on what you use as camera, than the encoding method.

comments.author: kevincharm
comments.story: Why can’t you buy a good webcam?
comments.why: Cited as a review of cheap HDMI capture cards.
comments.text: I use a similar setup with a Panasonic GH5 I already had, but I bought one of those €15 Chinese HDMI capture USB UVC cards [1]. These work surprisingly well, and I've had zero issues using them for ~4 hours back-to-back Zoom meetings on my MBP. They've also received some good reviews on YouTube [2]. For audio, I use my Airpods. Great setup for meetings. Latency is good enough IMO. -- [1]: [LINK] [2]: [VIDEO]
